definitions: An exclamation used to express strong agreement or understanding with someone's complaint or statement, often implying that one has had a similar experience.
Used to indicate that one is already very familiar with the situation being described, usually a negative one.
examples: "My commute was awful today." "Tell me about it! I was stuck in traffic for an hour."
"This project is taking forever." "Tell me about it! I've been working on it all weekend."
"The customer service was terrible." "Tell me about it! I had the same problem last week."
synonyms: tell me something I don't know
